heldTip: Time is held for you. Click to pause it instead.
why.stop: Held: read the card first. Carry on lets time run again.
why.answer: Held until you answer the event.
why.hidden: Held while this page is hidden.
why.build: Held while the build menu is open. Close it and time carries on.
why.tree: Held while the branches are open. Close them and time carries on.
why.laws: Held while the laws are open. Close them and time carries on.
why.settings: Held while the clock settings are open. Close them and time carries on.
why.why: Held while you read Why?. Close it and time carries on.
why.visit: Held while you visit. Finish the visit and time carries on.
why.warning: Held while you read the warning. Close it and time carries on.
why.term: Held while you read the term report. Close it and time carries on.
status.notStarted: Time is stopped. Nothing moves until you press Start time.
status.stepFresh: Time is stopped. Next season moves it on by three months.
status.paused: Paused. Press Play, or the Space bar, to carry on.
status.answered: Paused after your answer. Press Play when you are ready.
status.running: Time is running: a year every {n} seconds.
lesson.aria: How to pause time and change its speed
lesson.title: Time is running
lesson.pause: Press Pause, or the Space bar. You can build while paused.
lesson.speed: Steady is the slowest. Brisk and Fast are quicker. Keys 1, 2 and 3.
lesson.stops: Time also stops by itself when something needs you.
purse.full: Purse full: new coins are lost
purse.tip: You can hold {n} coins at most. Coins above that are not paid, so spend before it fills. A game rule (B1).
head.building: {n} of it is still on the way, all in by {year}
head.tip: Your result is the Wales you leave in 2050. It is {now} out of 100 now, and was {start} in 2026. It counts a build from the day you start it. A game estimate, not a forecast.
guide.map: Time is stopped until you press Start time, bottom left. This is South East Wales. Click the council you want to help.
guide.council: These bars are this council. The black tick is where it stood in 2026. Press Build, at the foot of this panel, to spend coins here.
guide.build: Point at a project. The map lights the lines its effect travels along. The bars show the change, dotted.
title.boardNote: The new game, 2026 to 2050. You play on the map. Time runs, and you pause it when you like. About 20 minutes.
title.first: Play the first game: all of Wales
title.firstNote: The first version, with cards and four-year turns. About 20 minutes.
title.resumeFirst: Carry on your game of the first version
